en.bdb: Accept the will of the Lord in the holy congregation ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: haumai garab nivaareeaai gurmukh ridhai gareebee aavai|

en.bdb: Repudiating pride and ego a gurmukh should be humble.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਭਰਮ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: giaan matee ghaT chaananaa bharam agiaan a(n)dher miTaavai|

en.bdb: With the light of knowledge in his mind he should dispel darkness of ignorance and delusions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਢਹਿ ਪਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: hoi nimaanaa ddeh pavai dharageh maan nimaanaa paavai|

en.bdb: He should fall on the feet (of Lord) in humility because only the humble are honoured in the court of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: khasamai soiee bhaavadhaa khasamai dhaa jis bhaanaa bhaavai|

en.bdb: Master also loves that man who loves the will of the master.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੈ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਨਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhaanaa ma(n)nai ma(n)neeaai aapanaa bhaanaa aap manaavai|

en.bdb: One who accepts the will of God is accepted by one understands that he is a guest in this world;

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ ਦਾਵਾ ਛਡਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਾ ਦਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhuneeaa vich paraahunaa dhaavaa chhadd rahai laa dhaavai|

en.bdb: That is why foregoing all claims, he lives without making any claim for himself.
Being in the holy congregation, he acts in consonance with the commands of the Lord.
